verdict.rationale: Figma ships a built-in AI agent (docs-17, docs-34, docs-51) that can generate design directions, edit images, search files, and collaborate with teammates 'in the same space,' matching the story's ask for a built-in assistant users can delegate to. However, hands-on community feedback specifically calls out that 'the AI tools in FigJam are really bad and often broken' (figma-comm-8), a concrete counter-claim to the polished vendor description, even as another user reports successful real-world use (figma-comm-9). Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or broader reviewer consensus on reliability, and clarity on whether the FigJam AI complaints extend to the core Figma agent features.
